Jio Financial, Groww, Laurus Labs, Airtel Among Stocks in Focus

Jio Financial's lending arm is reportedly set to receive a significant investment from Bank of America. Other factors influencing the stock market include changes by MSCI, infrastructure orders, revised plans by Airtel, and Krystal's acquisition of Citelum India. These developments are expected to act as stock-specific triggers for investors. Stocks like Jio Financial, TMPV, Apollo Hospitals, LG Electronics, and HAL are highlighted as ones to watch.
